# Step - as_number

`as_number` · `asNumber` · category: [Strings and type conversion](../../traversal/step_reference.md#strings-and-type-conversion)

Converts the value to a number, optionally of the given GType (GType.LONG truncates toward zero, see the book page Type Conversion and length()).

## Forms

```text
as_number()
as_number(arg1: GType)
as_number(arg1: GType, arg2: CastPolicy)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.inject("42", 3.9).as_number(GType.LONG).to_list()   // [42, 3]
```

## See also

- [Type Conversion](../../users_guide/type_conversion.md)
